description: Decay-aware claim format. Every factual claim in arifOS memory should eventually carry these fields.

claim_format.verified_at: ISO-8601 UTC — last time this claim was verified against reality
claim_format.initial_confidence: number 0.0-1.0 — confidence at time of verification (default: 0.9)
claim_format.source: origin of the claim (observation, measurement, inference)
claim_format.domain: which organ or system this claim relates to

query_modes.reverification_queue: list claims due for re-verification (confidence approaching 0.5)
